releases.title: 版本更新
content: 优化编辑器 Tab 键交互，列表和任务列表支持 Tab 降级、Shift+Tab 提升级，表格支持前后单元格导航。
代码块和 Markdown 源码模式支持单行及多行批量缩进，并修复连续按 Tab 时页面滚动和编辑焦点丢失的问题。
精简侧栏工作区操作，移除已有自动刷新机制下重复的手动刷新按钮。
优化图片、附件等内容块之间的点击编辑，未输入内容时自动清理临时空行。
新增 HTML 源码块，支持通过斜杠命令插入、语法高亮、实时安全预览、全屏编辑和源码无损保存，脚本内容不会执行。
完善普通段落和标题的 Tab 缩进，按 Tab 可插入两个空格，按 Shift+Tab 可移除光标前的一到两个缩进空格。
升级 Mermaid 图表编辑器，新增源码行号、Ctrl+Enter 快速保存，并优化编辑弹窗的标题、尺寸和定位。
优化提示块样式与编辑体验，强化类型辨识，支持 Ctrl+Enter 快速保存，并统一 Markdown 扩展内容的编辑弹窗布局。
contentEn: Improved Tab behavior: lists and task lists support Tab to demote and Shift+Tab to promote; tables navigate between cells.
Single-line and multi-line bulk indentation in code blocks and Markdown source mode; fixed page scrolling and focus loss when pressing Tab repeatedly.
Simplified workspace actions in the sidebar by removing the redundant manual refresh button now that automatic refresh exists.
Improved click-to-edit between images, attachments, and other blocks; temporary empty lines are cleaned up when no content is entered.
Added HTML source blocks: insert via slash command, with syntax highlighting, live safe preview, full-screen editing, and lossless source saving; scripts never execute.
Tab indentation for paragraphs and headings: Tab inserts two spaces, Shift+Tab removes one or two leading spaces before the cursor.
Upgraded the Mermaid editor with source line numbers, Ctrl+Enter to save, and improved dialog title, size, and positioning.
Improved callout styling and editing, stronger type distinction, Ctrl+Enter to save, and a consistent dialog layout for Markdown extension blocks.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
